business_summary: Nanjing Chixia Development Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the real estate industry in China. The company is also involved in real estate development; property operation and management; sales of building materials, building decoration materials, metal materials, daily necessities, and lighting fixtures; and investment activities. It also provides building decoration, real estate brokerage, real estate consulting, and engineering management, as well as residential and non-residential real estate rental services. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
